newsitem.title: USA: Santa Fe Pacific gets Twin Creek plan OK.
newsitem.headline: Santa Fe Pacific gets Twin Creek plan OK.

text.p: Santa Fe Pacific Gold Corp said Thursday it received U.S. Bureau of Land Management approval of its plan for the consolidation and expansion of existing mining and processing facilities and the construction of new facilities at the Twin Creeks Mine, northeast of Winnemucca, Nev.
The company said the approval enables the Twin Creeks Mine to process the refractory ores that represent about 67 percent of the total reserves at the Twin Creeks Mine.

In addition, the company said the approval provides more flexibility in the processing of ores shipped from other mines. This, the company said, is one more hurdle which has been overcome in its continuing efforts to produce one million ounces of gold in 1997 and 1.25 million ounces in 1998.
